# Spec: Query a document and render Markdown

[Specs](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/query-and-render-text.md)

**Start:** `/utilities/text`  
**Persona:** A developer pulling values out of mixed documents  
**Goal:** Query a JSON document with XPath, see the XML view XPath works on, and render Markdown.

**Table 1 — Acceptance criteria**

| Step | Action | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Run an XPath query | The match count and the matching elements are shown. |
| 2 | Render Markdown | The rendered preview appears. |

Source: `e2e/journeys.ts` (journey `query-and-render-text`). Each expected result is asserted by the step's `run` function.
